about.title: About GeoTurismoSV
about.subtitle: Discover the initiative behind our platform
about.p1: is born from the passion for our land. We are a Salvadoran initiative dedicated to showcasing the authentic beauty, landscapes, and cultural wealth of El Salvador.
about.p2: We believe planning your trip shouldn't be complicated. That's why we created a platform that solves the problem of scattered tourist information: we centralize the best destinations, magical spots, and recommendations in an organized, accessible, and intuitive system.
about.p3: Our mission is simple: to be the compass that inspires and guides you to your next great adventure within the "Tom Thumb of the Americas", helping you discover the destinations, culture, and unique experiences that make El Salvador an unforgettable place.
